O que o examinador quer (Task Achievement)
Sem opinião, sem causas, sem conclusão do tipo “In conclusion, I think…”
The most noticeable/striking feature is… · By far the highest… · A notable exception is… · In contrast… · Similarly…
approximately / around / just over / just under / roughly
(quando o número não é exato no gráfico)
The most striking feature is that sales in Japan were by far the highest, with one notable exception in 2015.

explanations.general: Falso: o overview é essencial para notas altas.

content.text: Antes de escrever, marque no gráfico apenas:

The graph shows internet users. In 2000 the UK was 27%, Brazil was 3% and India was 1%. In 2005 the UK was 70%, Brazil was 21% and India was 2%. In 2010 the UK was 85%, Brazil 41%, India 7%. In 2015 the UK was 92%, Brazil 59%, India 27%. In 2020 the UK was 95%, Brazil 81% and India 43%. In conclusion, I think the internet is very important.
introdução copiada · sem overview · lista ano a ano ·
The line graph compares the proportion of people using the internet in the UK, Brazil and India between 2000 and 2020.
Overall, internet use rose in all three countries, with the UK consistently recording the highest figures. The most striking growth occurred in Brazil.

In 2000, just over a quarter of the UK population (27%) used the internet, compared with only 3% in Brazil and 1% in India. Over the next two decades, the UK figure climbed to almost universal access, at 95%.

Brazil saw the most dramatic increase, rising from 3% to 81% by 2020. India also grew significantly, although its figure remained the lowest, reaching just under half the population (43%) at the end of the period.
4.1 Troque e fale: transformando frases imprecisas
The figure for the UK was 27%.
27% of the UK population used the internet.
1. Brazil was 81% in 2020. 2. Coffee was the most in 2015. 3. Cars were 55%. 4. Women were more than men.
Dados — CO₂ emissions per person (tonnes), 1990 and 2020:
Overall, the USA had the highest emissions and India had the lowest.
Overall, emissions per person fell in the two Western countries but rose in China and India, although the USA remained the highest emitter throughout.
Para os dados de CO₂, diga: maior, menor, maior mudança, semelhança (2020: Germany = China!).

options.text: The USA had the highest emissions and India had the lowest.
Emissions per person fell in the two Western countries but rose in China and India, although the USA remained the highest.

explanations.general: Correct answer: Emissions per person fell in the two Western countries but rose in China and India, although the USA remained the highest.

The USA and India had the same figure.

explanations.general: Correct answer: Germany and China had the same figure (8 tonnes).

explanations.general: Correct answer: The figure for Brazil reached 81% in 2020.

explanations.general: Correct answer: A higher proportion of women than men…

questions.questionText: In Task 1, you should describe every number for every year.

content.text: Dados — Average hours of sleep per night by age group, 2005 and 2025:

The chart shows average hours of sleep per night by age group in 2005 and 2025. In 2005 13–18 was 8.5, 19–30 was 7.8, 31–50 was 7.2 and 51+ was 7.0. In 2025 13–18 was 7.0, 19–30 was 6.9, 31–50 was 6.8 and 51+ was 7.1. Young people sleep less because they use phones at night. In conclusion, sleep is very important for health.
introdução parafraseada + overview + 2 parágrafos selecionados (150–170 palavras).
leia as duas versões. Liste 4 melhorias que você fez.
[ ] Overview com tendência geral (+ exceção do grupo 51+)?
[ ] Selecionou e agrupou em vez de listar?
Escreva overviews de 2 frases para 5 gráficos oficiais diferentes (sem escrever o resto).
Para 3 gráficos, marque maior, menor, maior mudança, semelhança, exceção.
Avalie a Task 1 do dia 3: overview? seleção? precisão? sem opinião?
Grave 1 minuto descrevendo o gráfico de sono (com overview oral).

questions.questionText: Sleep data: which group is the exception to the general trend?
Which group saw the biggest fall?
Which sentence should be removed from the weak answer?

options.text: The chart shows average hours of sleep…
Young people sleep less because they use phones at night.

explanations.general: Correct answer: Young people sleep less because they use phones at night.

options.text: Teenagers slept an average of 8.5 hours in 2005.

explanations.general: Correct answer: Teenagers slept an average of 8.5 hours in 2005.

questions.questionText: The most ______ change was among teenagers. (marcante — s…)

explanations.general: The most striking change was among teenagers.

content.text: 1 The figure for Brazil reached 81% in 2020. 2 Coffee was the most popular drink in 2015. 3 Cars accounted for 55% of journeys. 4 A higher proportion of women than men…
maior: EUA · menor: Índia · maior mudança: China (×4) · semelhança: Alemanha = China em 2020 (8 t).
Overall, average sleep time fell in every age group except the oldest, and the gap between the groups became much smaller. The sharpest decline was among teenagers.
